question: Am I improving across my race history?
note: Drafted against the exact prompt this request produces, pending a live re-record with `npm run record:demo`.

response.answer:
Not in a way the data can confirm yet. Your RaceIQ Score went from 1830 at Lakefront 10K (Sep 14, 2025) to 1842 at Brandywine Valley Marathon (Apr 19, 2026), +12, while your percentile moved from 98.6th to 92.3th, -6.3 pts. Those two point in opposite directions, and the four races are too different to line up directly: a 10km road race, a 105km gravel ride, a 50km singletrack race and a 42.2km road marathon.

Conditions explain more than the calendar does. Both strength verdicts came in cool weather, Tunkhannock Trail 50K at 6°C and Lakefront 10K at 14°C, and your one limiter, Brandywine, was run at 27°C. Your highest score, 1910, came at Tunkhannock. The honest read is that you race well in the cool and lose ground in heat. To measure improvement, you'd want two comparable races, such as two road marathons in similar weather.
